descriptionHtml:
Crucial DDR5 16GB 4800MHz CL40 Laptop RAM (16GB Single SODIMM Module / DDR5 4800MHz Speed / CL40 Latency / 1.1V Ultra-Low Voltage / On-Die ECC / Compatible with 12th, 13th Gen Intel & AMD Ryzen Laptops / 1 Year Warranty)

Upgrade your laptop performance with the Crucial DDR5 16GB 4800MHz CL40 SODIMM memory module, available at Turbo Computer Egypt with a 1-Year Warranty. Designed for next-generation gaming laptops and professional workstations powered by Intel and AMD mobile processors, DDR5 technology delivers up to 50% faster data transfer rates compared to DDR4. Operating at an energy-efficient 1.1V with built-in On-Die ECC (Error Correction Code) for enhanced data stability, this high-density module ensures smooth multitasking, faster load times, and superior responsiveness for heavy workloads.
